entry.name: clockFormat
entry.label: Panel chip time format (Qt date-time tokens; the 'ww' token is substituted with the ISO week by the widget)

entry.name: showDate
entry.label: Date in the panel chip (masks date tokens out of whatever format is set)

entry.name: worldClocks
entry.label: World clocks shown in the popup, as LABEL:Zone pairs comma separated (max 5), e.g. ET:America/New_York,PT:America/Los_Angeles

entry.name: timerMinutes
entry.label: Idle countdown timer preset in minutes (1-600)

entry.name: pomodoroFocusMin
entry.label: Pomodoro focus block length in minutes (1-120)

entry.name: weekStartDay
entry.label: Day the calendar week starts on (sunday..saturday); empty falls back to the locale

entry.name: timerEndsAt
entry.label: Transient: epoch-ms the manual countdown ends at

entry.name: timerRemainingMs
entry.label: Transient: remaining ms when the manual countdown is paused

entry.name: timerDoneAt
entry.label: Transient: epoch-ms the manual countdown fired at (the done ping ages out after 2 minutes)

entry.name: pomodoroEndsAt
entry.label: Transient: epoch-ms the current pomodoro phase ends at

entry.name: pomodoroCyclesDone
entry.label: Transient: focus blocks completed in the current pomodoro set
